paragraphs: Innventure is an industrial growth conglomerate that founds, funds, and operates companies with a focus on commercializing transformative, sustainable technology solutions acquired or licensed from multinational corporations ("MNCs") or other technology innovators (collectively, "Technology Solutions Providers") with the intent to maximize value for investors and other stakeholders through positive cash flow generated through long-term ownership of our Innventure Companies (as defined below). These Technology Solutions Providers are typically MNCs but need not be MNCs. In connection with the founding of a new company, we look to establish a collaborative relationship with at least one MNC that (1) has expressed a need for, and an interest in using or distributing, the specific technology that we intend to commercialize and (2) we expect will become a channel partner capable of providing a path to market adoption, distribution and/or revenue for the new company. This collaborating MNC, which we refer to as a channel partner, may be the entity from which we source the technology or it may be an unrelated entity. As owner-operators, our goal is to take what we believe to be breakthrough technologies that have advanced beyond proof of concept from evaluation to scaled commercialization utilizing an approach designed to help mitigate risk as we build disruptive companies that we believe have the potential to achieve a target enterprise value of at least $1 billion. When we say "disruptive," we mean innovations that, in our opinion, have the ability to significantly change the way businesses, industries, markets, and/or consumers operate. We have launched four such companies since inception: PureCycle Technologies, Inc. ("PureCycle" or "PCT"), AeroFlexx, LLC ("AeroFlexx" or "AFX"), Accelsius Holdings LLC ("Accelsius" or "ACC") and Refinity Olefins, LLC ("Refinity"). PureCycle, which converts polypropylene plastic waste into like-new plastic, was launched in late 2015 after sourcing technology from The Procter & Gamble Company ("P&G"); AeroFlexx, which manufactures sustainable liquid packaging, was launched in 2018 after sourcing technology from P Accelsius, which offers two-phase, direct-to-chip liquid cooling solutions for data centers, was launched in 2022 after sourcing technology from the Nokia Corporation ("Nokia"); and Refinity, which intends to commercialize technology that transforms plastic waste into valuable chemical intermediaries, was launched in 2024 after sourcing technology from the VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland ("VTT") and entering into a collaboration agreement with The Dow Chemical Company ("Dow"). PureCycle became a publicly traded company in 2021, and as of the date of this report, Innventure no longer has an economic interest in PureCycle. We refer to AeroFlexx, Accelsius, Refinity and all future operating subsidiary companies that Innventure may found, fund, and operate going forward as the "Innventure Companies." We operate the Innventure Companies through a conglomerate model (the "Disruptive Conglomerate Model") through which we operate the Innventure Companies across diverse sectors. This model is designed to mitigate the single-asset risk inherent in commercializing emerging industrial technologies by building and operating multiple Innventure Companies. Through a shared services model, we provide direct operational support to the Innventure Companies, including accounting, finance, legal, human resources and IT support. We provide initial funding to the Innventure Companies and look to have these companies secure direct funding from third parties as they mature.

Innventure's approach to identifying and commercializing disruptive technology opportunities is designed to help mitigate the risks associated with building start-up businesses by sourcing technology from MNCs and other technology innovators. An important part of our approach is our collaboration with MNCs. These relationships assist us in identifying disruptive opportunities by giving us access to thoroughly researched and well-protected technology solutions that potentially satisfy unmet market needs, along with market data and customer insights unavailable to most new ventures. We seek MNC relationships that we believe can provide value as channel partners and serve as catalysts for market adoption of the technology solutions we look to commercialize.

We use our systematic, repeatable "DownSelect" process to analyze each opportunity across a range of key success factors, including: (1) the disruptive potential, (2) the likelihood for accelerated early adoption driven by economic value creation, (3) the potential to materially address sustainability issues and drive economic value for business-to-business ("B2B") customers, (4) the ability to create sustainable competitive advantage, (5) the projected ability to generate rapid, sizable financial returns and (6) the potential to create target enterprise value of at least $1 billion. DownSelect uses MNC's proprietary market and customer data along with our own rigorous
analytics to assess each opportunity and seeks opportunities for the MNC to help accelerate early market adoption by becoming early customers or offering channel access.

The DownSelect process consists of four separate phases, with successive phases building on work done in the previous phases and deepening the level of analyses done as opportunities progress through the process.

Phase 1 – Opportunity Screen: Innventure's team screens opportunities that are reflective of the four dimensions of the DownSelect Process: (1) technology developed by an MNC or other technology innovator, (2) significant market need, (3) transformative solution and (4) strategic execution. We analyze high-level business, financial, and technology issues to determine if the opportunity meets our key success criteria.

Phase 2 – Critical Factor Assessment: We identify, assess, and prioritize an opportunity's critical success and risk factors and develop a plan (to be executed in Phase 3) for in-depth systematic evaluation to quantify value, address critical factors for success of a new business built around the opportunity, and mitigate risk factors. This is an internal assessment to determine if an opportunity is sizable, transformative, and meets the minimum threshold for advancement.

Phase 3 – Comprehensive Quantification: The Innventure team conducts a comprehensive review across all DownSelect dimensions. A core focus is on quantitative analysis and strategy of the immediate new value created for customers. We quantify the potential economic value to the B2B customer, create a pricing model that is sufficiently compelling to predictably drive early adoption, and conduct bottoms-up, real-world testing to further validate key hypotheses, especially around enabling critical success factors and mitigating critical risks. We develop initial financials, including revenue models and capital and operating cost estimates; define preliminary organizational structures and business plans; conduct field validations, often including prospective customer interviews, pilot manufacturing and additional concept and product testing, to help validate critical assumptions.

For an opportunity that successfully passes through Phase 3, the DownSelect team, in collaboration with Innventure senior leadership, recommends to the Board of Directors (the "Board") that the opportunity move to Phase 4 and proceed to create a new Innventure Company.

Phase 4 – Strategy & Formation: We set the initial strategy, including go-to-market strategies and initial business plan, for the Innventure Company, secure control of the technology via licensing or ownership, and create the new company.

The DownSelect process typically takes six to nine months, though it may take as little as a few weeks to decline an opportunity and as long as a year or more from the start of Phase 1 to full approval to launch a new company. The process is managed by the DownSelect team with support from the broader Innventure team as well as external subject matter experts as required. The primary goal of the process is to confirm that an opportunity meets the key DownSelect criteria, and that we believe that the business has the potential to achieve or exceed a target enterprise value of at least $1 billion. At the completion of the DownSelect process, a new Innventure Company is created, and the approved opportunity is transferred to the new company, at which time Innventure appoints the board of directors and initial management team, typically consisting of Innventure principals and personnel. Innventure selects executives and managers who it believes to have the requisite technical and operational expertise to scale enterprises built around disruptive technologies. Previously, Innventure owned and operated the Innventure Companies and maintained control at least through early scaling. As part of the new Disruptive Conglomerate Model, Innventure intends to retain control of the Innventure Companies that it has created since 2022.

When an opportunity satisfies our DownSelect criteria, we seek to acquire or license the technology solution from the MNC or other technology innovators and use the initial business plans developed during our DownSelect process as the basis to launch a new "Innventure Company" with initial funding provided by Innventure. From an investor perspective, this model is intended to bring founder shares of a company with a target enterprise value of at least $1 billion onto the Innventure balance sheet, which we believe can provide excellent potential returns for Innventure shareholders as described in more detail in this section.

Historically, and prior to the Business Combination (as defined below), the Innventure model targeted exits for our new companies at 5-7 years after inception through a sale, initial public offering or merger, including a merger with a special purpose acquisition company. However, we determined that this approach could result in exiting companies prior to creating their maximum shareholder value.

As we continue to advance our Disruptive Conglomerate Model, we intend to focus on building and holding companies, with goals of generating positive cash flows of one or more Innventure Companies controlled by Innventure and maximizing value for investors and other stakeholders. We believe that holding controlling stakes in our Innventure Companies allows those companies to mature further and gives us the opportunity to derive greater value from those companies as we operate them over the long term. We are currently deploying this model for Accelsius and Refinity. While an opportunistic sale or other disposition of one or more of our controlled companies could occur in the future, exit transactions are not expected to be a factor in the business plans for Accelsius, Refinity or future Innventure Companies.

headings: Innventure may not be able to obtain additional financing to fund the operations and growth of the business.

There is uncertainty regarding Innventure's ability to maintain liquidity sufficient to operate its business effectively, which raises substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern.
Innventure depends on its Innventure Companies for revenue and cash, and the Innventure Companies are not guaranteed to succeed.
Our growth strategy depends on our ability to scale our Innventure Companies effectively, and we may be unable to do so successfully.
The WTI Facility may impair Innventure LLC's, the Company's and the Innventure Companies' financial and operating flexibility.
It is not possible to predict the actual number of shares Innventure will sell under the SEPA to Yorkville, or the actual gross proceeds resulting from those sales.
Innventure's success will depend on its ability to attract and retain personnel and manage human capital both for itself and the Innventure Companies, while controlling labor costs.
Risks Related to the Innventure Companies' Operations
The Innventure Companies are early-stage companies, and their limited operating history makes it difficult to evaluate their future prospects and the risks and challenges they may encounter.

Failure of our Innventure Companies to achieve and maintain a high level of product and service quality and on-time delivery could damage their reputations with customers and negatively impact our results.
Accelsius' cooling products may be subject to increased regulatory scrutiny due to their use of working fluid refrigerants that contain fluorine.
Accelsius' results of operations may be adversely affected by long and unpredictable deployment cycles in the data center market, which could delay or reduce the conversion of bookings into revenue.
Accelsius may not realize all of the sales expected from its backlog of orders and contracts.
Accelsius' purchase orders to date have been received from a limited number of customers, and this customer concentration could materially adversely affect our business.
Refinity faces risks in designing, constructing and operating its first commercial-scale manufacturing facility, and it may be unable to successfully or timely complete and bring the facility online.
Risks Related to Our Common Stock
The market price of our Common Stock is likely to be highly volatile, and you may lose some or all of your investment.
Volatility in Innventure's share price could subject Innventure to securities class action litigation.
Additional financing transactions by the Innventure Companies could impact your rights as a stockholder of Innventure.

Stockholder activism or unsolicited acquisition proposals could disrupt our business, divert management's attention and impede our ability to execute our business model and achieve our long-term strategic objectives.
The market may not fully understand or accept our conglomerate structure and the value of our Innventure Companies, which could cause our common stock to trade at a discount to our net asset value.
Provisions in the A&R Certificate of Incorporation and under Delaware law could discourage a takeover that stockholders may consider favorable and may lead to entrenchment of management.

In assessing these risks, you should also refer to the other information included in this Form 10-K, including the consolidated financial statements and notes thereto and the section entitled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." The Company's business, financial condition or results of operations could be affected materially and adversely by any of the risks discussed below. We cannot assure you that any of the events discussed below will not occur.
Our business is subject to a number of risks and uncertainties. Some of these principal risks include the following:
•Innventure may not be able to obtain additional financing to fund the operations and growth of the business.

•There is uncertainty regarding Innventure's ability to maintain liquidity sufficient to operate its business effectively, which raises substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern.
•Innventure depends on its Innventure Companies for revenue and cash, and the Innventure Companies are not guaranteed to succeed.

•Innventure may not be successful in finding future opportunities to license or acquire breakthrough technology solutions from Technology Solutions Providers, and any failure to satisfy the requirement of or maintain relationships with its technology providers could materially aversely affect its business.

paragraphs: Unless the context otherwise requires, references in this section to "we", "us" and "our" refer to the business and operations of Innventure LLC and its consolidated subsidiaries prior to the Business Combination, which became the business of the Company and its subsidiaries following the consummation of the Business Combination. Unless otherwise indicated, all dollar amounts ("$") are expressed in thousands.

The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our and our predecessor's, as applicable, consolidated financial statements and related notes and other information included elsewhere in this Form 10-K. This discussion contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results could differ materially from such forward-looking statements. Factors that could cause or contribute to those differences include, but are not limited to, those identified below in this section and those discussed in the sections titled "Risk Factors" and "Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward–Looking Statements" included elsewhere in this Form 10-K. Additionally, our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for any period in the future.

Innventure is an industrial growth conglomerate that founds, funds, and operates companies with a focus on commercializing transformative, sustainable technology solutions acquired or licensed from MNCs or other technology innovators with the intent to maximize values for investors and other stakeholders through positive cash flow generated through holding long term positions in our Innventure Companies. Refer to Item 1. "Business" of this Form 10-K for a detailed discussion of our business activities.

Based on the allocation of resources and assessment of financial performance by our Chief Executive Officer (who has been determined to be our Chief Operating Decision Maker), we have identified one reportable segment: Technology. The Company's remaining operations are not reportable segments and are classified as "Other". "Other" primarily includes the Company's remaining operations consisting of Innventure's original platform business, service activities, Refinity and equity method investment activities.

On October 24, 2023, Learn CW and Innventure LLC entered into a Business Combination Agreement with Holdco, LCW Merger Sub and Innventure Merger Sub. On September 30, 2024, the stockholders of Learn CW approved the Business Combination, and the Business Combination closed on the Closing Date. The Business Combination has been accounted for using the acquisition method of accounting. The Company determined the accounting acquirer to be Holdco. Accordingly, the Company recorded assets acquired, liabilities assumed and non-controlling interest at their acquisition date fair values and recognized goodwill.

As a consequence of the Business Combination, Innventure, Inc. is the successor to an SEC-registered and Nasdaq listed company which will require Innventure to hire additional personnel and implement procedures and processes to address public company regulatory requirements and customary practices. Innventure expects to incur additional annual expenses as a public company for, among other things, directors' and officers' liability insurance, director fees and additional internal and external accounting and legal and administrative resources, including increased audit and legal fees.
Innventure's future results of consolidated operations and financial position may not be comparable to historical results as a result of the Business Combination.
The year ended December 31, 2025 includes the following highlights:
•Innventure's Technology segment began generating revenue related to its cooling systems for data centers.

•Total operational expenses of approximately $466.8 million, primarily made up of a goodwill impairment charge and increased costs associated with generating revenue for the Technology Segment, professional and legal fees, and sales and advertising costs for the year ended December 31, 2025.

•Cash inflows from equity and net debt raises were approximately $139.3 million for the year ended December 31, 2025. These cash inflows from equity and net debt raises are compared to net cash outflows related to operating and investing activities of $84.8 million for the year ended December 31, 2025.

paragraphs: Innventure 是一家工業成長綜合企業，專注於創辦、資助並運營公司，重點在於商業化從跨國企業（"MNCs"）或其他科技創新者（ collectively, "Technology Solutions Providers"）取得或授權的變革性、可持續性科技解決方案，以最大化對投資者及其他利害關係人的價值，透過長期持有我們的 Innventure Companies（如下所定）所產生的正向現金流。這些 Technology Solutions Providers 通常是 MNCs，但不一定要是 MNCs。在創辦新公司時，我們會尋求與至少一家 MNC 建立合作關係，該 MNC（1）已表達對特定科技的需要，並有意使用或分銷該科技，以及（2）我們預期該 MNC 將成為能提供市場採用、分銷和/或收入途徑的通路夥伴。此 collaborating MNC，我們稱為通路夥伴，可能是我們取得科技的機構，也可能是無關的機構。作為擁有者與經營者，我們的目標是將我們認為已超越概念驗證階段的突破性科技，透過一種設計用以協助降低風險的模式，從評估階段轉入規模化商業化，以建立我們認為有潛力達到至少 10 億美元企業價值的顛覆性公司。當我們說 "顛覆性" 時，我們指的是我們認為有潛力顯著改變企業、產業、市場和/或消費者運作方式的創新。自成立以來，我們已啟動四家公司：PureCycle Technologies, Inc.（"PureCycle" 或 "PCT"）、AeroFlexx, LLC（"AeroFlexx" 或 "AFX"）、Accelsius Holdings LLC（"Accelsius" 或 "ACC"）以及 Refinity Olefins, LLC（"Refinity"）。PureCycle，將聚丙烯塑料廢料轉化為如新塑料，於 2015 年晚期啟動，取得技術來自 The Procter & Gamble Company（"P&G"）；AeroFlexx，製造可持續液態包裝，於 2018 年啟動，取得技術來自 P Accelsius，提供兩階段、直接至晶片液態冷卻解決方案給資料中心，於 2022 年啟動，取得技術來自 Nokia Corporation（"Nokia"）；以及 Refinity，意圖商業化將塑料廢料轉化為價值化化學中間體的技術，於 2024 年啟動，取得技術來自 VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland（"VTT"），並與 The Dow Chemical Company（"Dow"）簽訂合作協議。PureCycle 於 2021 年成為公開上市公司，且截至本報告日，Innventure 已不再擁有 PureCycle 的經濟利益。我們將 AeroFlexx、Accelsius、Refinity 以及 Innventure 未來可能創辦、資助並運營的任何營運子公司公司稱為 "Innventure Companies"。我們透過一綜合企業模式（"顛覆性綜合企業模式"）運營 Innventure Companies，透過此模式，我們在多樣產業中運營 Innventure Companies。此模式設計用以降低商業化新興工業科技所固有的單一資產風險，透過建立和運營多個 Innventure Companies。透過共享服務模式，我們為 Innventure Companies 提供直接運營支援，包括會計、財務、法律、人力資源及資訊科技支援。我們為 Innventure Companies 提供初始資金，並期望這些公司隨著成熟而從第三方取得直接資金。

Innventure 透過識別並商業化顛覆性科技機會的作法，旨在幫助降低建立新創企業的風險，透過從 MNCs 及其他科技創新者取得科技。我們方法中重要的一部分是與 MNCs 的合作。這些關係協助我們識別顛覆性機會，透過提供我們取得經過深入研究且受良好保護的科技解決方案，這些解決方案潛在地可滿足未被滿足的市場需求，以及市場資料與客戶見解，這些對大多數新創企業而言是無法取得的。我們尋求我們認為能作為通路夥伴並成為科技解決方案市場採用催化劑的 MNC 關係。

我們使用我們系統化、可重複的 "DownSelect" 流程，來分析每個機會在一系列關鍵成功因素上的表現，包括：(1) 預期的顛覆潛力、(2) 由經濟價值創造所驅動的加速早期採用可能性、(3) 有潛力大幅解決永續性問題並為企業對企業 ("B2B") 客戶創造經濟價值、(4) 創造可持續競爭優勢的能力、(5) 預期能產生快速且規模龐大的財務回報能力，以及 (6) 有潛力創造至少 1 十億美元目標企業價值。DownSelect 會使用 MNC 的專屬市場與客戶資料，以及我們嚴謹的
分析來評估每個機會，並尋求機會讓 MNC 能透過成為早期客戶或提供通路存取，來加速早期市場採用。
DownSelect 流程包含四個獨立階段，後續階段建立在前一階段的工作之上，並隨著機會在流程中推進而深化分析層次。
第一階段 – 機會篩選：Innventure 團隊篩選反映 DownSelect 流程四個維度的機會：（1）由 MNC 或其他科技創新者開發的科技、（2）重大市場需求、（3）變革性解決方案，以及（4）戰略執行。我們分析高層次的業務、財務及科技問題，以判斷機會是否符合我們的關鍵成功準則。
第二階段 – 關鍵因素評估：我們識別、評估並優先考量機會的關鍵成功與風險因素，並制定計畫（於第三階段執行），進行深入系統化評估，以量化價值、解決新企業圍繞機會的關鍵成功因素，並降低風險因素。這是內部評估，以判斷機會是否規模足夠、具有變革性，並符合最低進展門檻。

第三階段 – 全面量化：Innventure 團隊對所有 DownSelect 維度進行全面審查。核心重點在於對客戶立即新價值的量化分析與策略。我們量化 B2B 客戶的潛在經濟價值，建立足夠有吸引力的定價模型以預測性驅動早期採用，並進行自下而上的現實世界測試，進一步驗證關鍵假設，特別是關於啟動關鍵成功因素與降低關鍵風險。我們制定初步財務資料，包括收入模型與資本及營運成本預估；定義初步組織架構與業務計畫；進行現場驗證，常包括預期客戶訪談、試製製造及額外概念與產品測試，以協助驗證關鍵假設。
對於一個成功通過第三階段的機會，DownSelect 團隊會與Innventure 高階領導層合作，建議董事會（"董事會"）該機會進入第四階段，並繼續進行創建新的Innventure 公司。
第四階段 – 策略與成立：我們為Innventure 公司設定初始策略，包括市場進入策略與初始商業計畫，取得技術的控制權（透過授權或擁有權），並成立新的公司。

DownSelect 作業通常需要六到九個月，不過也可能在幾週內拒絕一個機會，或從第一階段開始到完全批准啟動新公司，可能長達一年或更久。此流程由 DownSelect 團隊管理，並在需要時獲得廣泛 Innventure 團隊及外部專業領域專家的支持。此流程的主要目標是確認一個機會符合關鍵 DownSelect 標準，並相信該業務有潛力達到或超越至少 10 億美元的目標企業價值。在 DownSelect 作業完成後，會成立一個新的 Innventure 公司，並將已批准的機會轉移至新公司，此時 Innventure 會任命董事會及初始管理團隊，通常由 Innventure 原創始人及人員組成。Innventure 選擇執行長及經理，其認為這些人擁有足夠的技術及運營專業知識，以擴展建立在顛覆性科技周圍的企業。先前，Innventure 會擁有並運營 Innventure 公司，並至少在早期擴張階段維持控制權。根據新的顛覆性綜合體模式，Innventure 計畫保留自 2022 年以來所創立的 Innventure 公司的控制權。

當一個機會符合我們的 DownSelect 標準時，我們會尋求從 MNC 或其他科技創新者取得或授權技術解決方案，並以我們在 DownSelect 過程中所發展的初始商業計畫作為基礎，成立一個新的 "Innventure Company"，並由 Innventure 提供初始資金。從投資者觀點來看，此模式旨在將一家目標企業價值至少為 10 億美元公司的創始人股份納入 Innventure 的資產負債表，我們認為這可以為 Innventure 股東提供優良的潛在回報，如本節更詳細說明。
歷史上，在業務結合（如後文所定義）之前，Innventure 模式針對我們的新公司設定了在成立後5至7年內透過出售、首次公開發行或合併（包括與特殊目的收購公司合併）實現退出的目標。然而，我們認為這種方法可能導致公司在創造最大股東價值之前就進行退出。

隨著我們持續推進顛覆性企業集團模式，我們意圖專注於建立並持有公司，目標是產生一個或多個由Innventure 控制的Innventure 公司的正向現金流，並為投資者及其他利害關係人最大化價值。我們認為，持有對我們Innventure 公司的控制權，可以讓這些公司進一步成熟，並讓我們在長遠運營這些公司時，有機會從這些公司中獲得更大的價值。目前，我們正在為Accelsius 和 Refinity 運用此模式。雖然未來可能有機會出售或處分一個或多個我們控制的公司，但退出交易不預期會成為Accelsius、Refinity 或未來Innventure 公司的業務計畫因素。

paragraphs: 除非文意另有要求，本節中提及的「我們」、「我們」及「我們的」均指 Innventure LLC 及其合併子公司在業務合併前的業務與運作，該業務在業務合併完成後成為本公司及其子公司的業務。除非另有說明，所有金額（「$」）均以千為單位表示。

請配合本公司及本公司前身（如有）的合併財務報表及其相關附註，以及本 Form 10-K 其他部分所包含的其他資訊，來閱讀我們對財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析。本討論包含風險與不確定性之預測性陳述。我們的實際結果可能與這些預測性陳述有重大差異。導致這些差異的因素包括，但不僅限於，本節中所識別的以下因素，以及本 Form 10-K 其他部分標題為「風險因素」及「預測性陳述警示」的段落中所討論的相關因素。此外，我們的歷史結果未必能代表未來任何一段期間的結果。
Innventure 是一家工業成長綜合企業，專注於創立、資金籌措與營運公司，以商業化從 MNCs 或其他科技創新者取得或授權的轉型、可持續性科技解決方案，並透過在 Innventure 公司中持有長期股份，以產生正向現金流，為投資者及其他利害關係人創造最大價值。請參閱本 Form 10-K 的「業務」項目，以獲得有關我們業務活動的詳細討論。
根據我們首席執行長（已確定為我們的首席運營決策者）對資源配置與財務表現的評估，我們已識別出一個應報告分部：科技。本公司其餘運作不屬於應報告分部，並歸類為「其他」。「其他」主要包含本公司其餘運作，包括 Innventure 原始平台業務、服務活動、Refinity 及權益法投資活動。

2023 年 10 月 24 日，Learn CW 與 Innventure LLC 與 Holdco、LCW Merger Sub 與 Innventure Merger Sub 籤訂業務合併協議。2024 年 9 月 30 日，Learn CW 的股東批准該業務合併，且該業務合併於 Closing Date 完成。該業務合併已採用收購法進行會計處理。本公司已確定會計買方為 Holdco。因此，本公司已按取得日的公允價值記錄取得的資產、承擔的負債及非控制性權益，並確認商譽。
由於業務合併，Innventure, Inc. 成為一家 SEC 登記並在 Nasdaq 上市的公司，這將要求 Innventure 僱用更多員工，並實施程序與作業流程以符合公開公司監管要求及慣例作法。Innventure 預期會因成為公開上市公司而產生額外年度費用，包括董事與高階管理人員責任保險、董事費以及額外的內部與外部會計、法律及行政資源，包括增加的審計與法律費用。
由於業務合併，Innventure 的合併營運成果與財務狀況可能與歷史結果不具可比性。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的會計年度包含以下重點：
•Innventure 的資訊科技分部開始產生與其資料中心冷卻系統相關的營業收入。
•總營運費用約為 466.8 百萬美元，主要由商譽減損費用及因資訊科技分部產生營業收入而增加的成本、專業及法律費用，以及 2025 年 12 月 31 日為止的銷售及廣告費用組成。
•2025 年 12 月 31 日為止，來自股東權益及淨債務籌資的現金流入約為 139.3 百萬美元。這些來自股東權益及淨債務籌資的現金流入，與 2025 年 12 月 31 日為止的營運及投資活動相關的淨現金流出 84.8 百萬美元相比。
為反映因企業合併而應用不同會計基礎的影響，下列表格以黑色線條將本公司結果分為兩個不同期間，如下：(1) 至及包括交割日（標記為「前公司」）及 (2) 交割日後的期間（標記為「後公司」）。2024 年 10 月 1 日之後的期間為「後公司」期間，而 2024 年 10 月 2 日之前的期間為「前公司」期間。

管理層認為，將 2024 年 12 月 31 日為止十二個月的營運結果，結合前公司與後公司期間的結果（「S/P 合併」）來討論我們整體營運表現，比起與前一年同期相比更具參考價值。下列討論中包含的合併營運結果，並未依照美國會計準則（U.S. GAAP）編製，也未依照適用的法規編製為形式財務結果，可能無法反映若企業合併於財務年度開始時發生，我們實際可能達到的結果，因此不應視為前公司與後公司期間依照 GAAP 呈現的營運結果之替代。

headings: 與 Innventure 事業相關的風險
Innventure 可能無法取得額外融資以支應業務運作及成長所需資金。
Innventure 保持足夠流動性以有效運作其業務的能力存在不確定性，這使本公司持續經營的疑慮相當重大。
Innventure 依賴其 Innventure Companies 產生收入與現金，而 Innventure Companies 是否成功並無保證。
本公司成長策略依賴本公司能有效擴展 Innventure Companies，而本公司可能無法成功做到這一點。
WTI 信貸協議可能影響 Innventure LLC、本公司及 Innventure Companies 的財務與營運彈性。
無法預測 Innventure 在 SEPA 下實際出售給 Yorkville 的股票數量，或這些銷售實際產生的毛收入金額。
Innventure 的成功將取決於其吸引並留住人才、管理人力資本的能力，同時控制勞動成本，不僅針對本公司，也針對 Innventure Companies。
與 Innventure Companies 操作相關的風險
Innventure Companies 屬於早期階段的公司，其有限的營運歷史使其難以評估未來前景以及可能遇到的風險與挑戰。
若 Innventure Companies 未能維持高水準的產品與服務品質及準時交貨，可能會損害其與客戶的聲譽，並對我們的營運結果產生負面影響。
Accelsius 的散熱產品可能因使用含氟的工質冷卻劑而面臨增加的監管審查。
Accelsius 的營運結果可能因資料中心市場中長且不可預測的部署週期而受到不利影響，這可能會延遲或減少訂單轉換為收入的過程。
Accelsius 可能無法實現其訂單與合約積累中預期的所有銷售額。
截至目前為止，Accelsius 的採購訂單主要來自有限數量的客戶，這種客戶集中度可能會對我們的業務產生重大不利影響。
Refinity 面臨在設計、建造及營運其第一座商業規模製造廠房時的風險，且可能無法成功或按時完成並啟用該廠房。
與我們普通股相關的風險
我們普通股的市場價格可能出現高度波動，您可能損失部分或全部投資。
Innventure 的股票價格波動可能使其成為證券集體訴訟的目標。
Innventure 公司的追加融資交易可能影響您作為 Innventure 股東之權利。
股東 activism 或未經邀請的收購提案可能幹擾我們的業務，分散管理階層的注意力，並阻礙我們執行業務模式及達成長期戰略目標的能力。
市場可能未能完全理解或接受我們的綜合企業結構及 Innventure 公司的價值，這可能會導致我們普通股以低於淨資產價值的價格交易。
A&R 營業執照章程及特拉華州法律中的條款可能抑制股東認為有利的收購，並可能導致管理階層固守現狀。
paragraphs: 您應仔細考慮下列風險因素，並配合本 Form 10-K 所包含的所有其他資訊。本公司普通股（每股票面價值 0.0001 美元，"普通股"）的市場價格可能因這些風險而下跌，導致您可能損失全部或部分投資。評估這些風險時，您應同時參考本 Form 10-K 所包含的其他資訊，包括合併財務報表及其附註，以及名為 "管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析" 的部分。本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果可能因下列討論的任何風險而受到重大且不利的影響。我們無法保證下列所討論的任何事件不會發生。
本公司業務面臨許多風險與不確定性。其中一些主要風險包括以下內容：
•Innventure 可能無法取得額外資金以支應業務運作與成長所需。
•Innventure 在維持足夠流動性以有效運作其業務方面存在不確定性，這會對其持續經營產生重大疑慮。
•Innventure 依賴其 Innventure Companies 來取得收入與現金，而 Innventure Companies 並無保證會成功。
•Innventure 可能無法成功尋找未來機會，以從科技解決方案供應商處取得突破性科技解決方案，且若未能符合或維持與其科技供應商的關係，可能會對其業務造成重大不利影響。
